Is that the only place that checks readme in the testing?

If you mean **target/root `README.md` content**, yes: the removed assertion in [`envelope.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d260568305ef79d5bd9cded94153876d5790d557/.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts#L474-L484) was the only test I found that checked the repo root README for `AGENT_ENABLED=false`.

There are still README-related tests, but they are different:

- [`docs-validation.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d260568305ef79d5bd9cded94153876d5790d557/.agent/src/__tests__/docs-validation.test.ts#L47) rejects `.agent/docs/**/README.md` in favor of `index.md`.
- [`memory-artifacts.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d260568305ef79d5bd9cded94153876d5790d557/.agent/src/__tests__/memory-artifacts.test.ts#L16) and [`memory-init-cli.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d260568305ef79d5bd9cded94153876d5790d557/.agent/src/__tests__/memory-init-cli.test.ts#L29) check generated `agent/memory` branch README files.
- [`memory-bootstrap-branch-cli.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d260568305ef79d5bd9cded94153876d5790d557/.agent/src/__tests__/memory-bootstrap-branch-cli.test.ts#L68) checks the bootstrapped memory branch README.
- [`rubrics.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d260568305ef79d5bd9cded94153876d5790d557/.agent/src/__tests__/rubrics.test.ts#L49) checks that the rubrics branch layout includes a README.

So PR #397 removes the only **root README content coupling**. It does not remove tests for Sepo-owned generated README artifacts or docs layout rules.
